name: Photodump
summary: Four photos of you from one photo, in four scenes of an aesthetic, like a feed photo dump, in one run (FLUX 3 Image Klein).

source.notes: apps/edit's pipeline four times over the same photo: four prompts (the aesthetic select writes all four, nodes 4 and pd_t2-4), four ReferenceMultiLatent and four samplers with the same seed, joined with ImageBatch into one SaveImage. Each of the four starts from its own empty 2:3 latent (EmptyFlux2LatentImage, node ff_size) with its own framing: full body, half body, from the side, a mirror selfie. Runs 20261026-002124-l40s and -003153-l40s, which started from the photo's latent shape, kept the photo's pose and framing in two to four of the photos.

inputs.label: Aesthetic
inputs.help: Four photos, one per scene of the aesthetic, all with the person from your photo.
